in_hebrew.name: זוסימוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם זוסימוס מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'חיים ניצולים או שרדו'. הוא קשור למושגים של הישרדות וקיום. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת הנוצרית ומופיע בכתבי הקודש ובתולדות הקדושים.

in_greek.name: Ζώσιμος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζώσιμος προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'ζωή' (ζω) και 'σῶμα' (σω). σημαίνει 'αυτό που σώζει τη ζωή' ή 'ζωντανός'. Στο πλαίσιο του Χριστιανισμού, το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της σωτηρίας και της αιώνιας ζωής.

in_latin.name: Zosimus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Zosimus is derived from the Greek words 'zoe' (life) and 'soma' (body). In a Christian context, it signifies 'preserved, saved or survivor'. The name was borne by several early Christian saints and popes, highlighting its significance in Christian tradition.

in_english.name: Zosimus
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zosimus originates from Greek roots 'zoe' (life) and 'soma' (body), signifying 'preserved, saved or survivor'. It holds spiritual significance in Christianity, symbolizing salvation and eternal life. Historically, the name was associated with several Christian saints and popes, reflecting its importance in Christian tradition and culture.

saint_reference.note: Pope Zosimus was a bishop of Rome from 417 to 418 AD.

data.cultural_impact: St. Zosimus of Cyprus was a bishop who played a significant role in the early Christian Church, contributing to its development and growth through his pastoral work and writings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zosimus signifies a deep connection to the divine and the belief in the power of God to sustain and give life. This name is a reminder of the spiritual journey towards union with God and the importance of living a God-centered life.
